title: The positive-scale members μ₀^{x,λ} built from one rescaled ball of a measure: support relation, injectivity (mass and barycenter), finite positive mass, domains, domain recovery under vague limits, non-homogeneity, transferred lower bound (parent steps 2, 3, 7, 12–14)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, μ a measure on ℝ^P, z ∈ ℝ^P and r > 0 with μ(B_{2r}(z)) ≠ 0 and μ(B_{2r}(z)) ≠ ∞, and let μ₀ be the measure μ₀ = ofReal(r^{−n})•(μ⌞B_{2r}(z)).map(dilation z r). For x ∈ ℝ^P and λ > 0 write μ₀^{x,λ} := ofReal(λ^{−n})•μ₀.map(dilation x λ) and G_{x,λ} := dilation x λ '' B_2(0); call (x, λ) admissible if 0 < λ ≤ 1 and ‖x‖ ≤ 1 − λ; 'f_i → ν vaguely' means ∫ f dν_i → ∫ f dν for every continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^P → ℝ. Then: (1) for every w ∈ B_2(0): (μ₀(B_ε(w)) ≠ 0 for all ε > 0) ⟺ (μ(B_ε(z + r·w)) ≠ 0 for all ε > 0); (2) if λ, λ' > 0 and μ₀^{x,λ} = μ₀^{x',λ'}, then x = x' and λ = λ'; (3) for λ > 0, μ₀^{x,λ}(ℝ^P) ≠ 0 and μ₀^{x,λ}(ℝ^P) ≠ ∞; (4) for admissible (x, λ), G_{x,λ} is open and B_2(0) ⊆ G_{x,λ}; (5) if (x_i, λ_i) (i ∈ ℕ) are admissible, ν is a measure with ν(K') ≠ ∞ for every compact K', μ₀^{x_i,λ_i} → ν vaguely, K ⊆ ℝ^P is compact and K ⊄ G_{x_i,λ_i} for every i, then there is an admissible (x, λ) with ν = μ₀^{x,λ} and K ⊄ G_{x,λ}; (6) for λ > 0 and every f : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] with f(t·w) = f(w) for all t > 0 and w, μ₀^{x,λ} ≠ μHE[n].withDensity f; (7) if Λ₀ ≥ 0 and μ satisfies ofReal(e^{−(Λ₀σ)})·(ω_n·ofReal(σ^n)) ≤ μ(B_σ(p)) whenever μ(B_ε(p)) ≠ 0 for all ε > 0, closedBall p ρ ⊆ closedBall z (2r) and 0 < σ < ρ (ω_n = unitBallVolume n), then for all x, y ∈ ℝ^P, 0 < λ ≤ 1 and ρ > 0 with closedBall y ρ ⊆ G_{x,λ} and μ₀^{x,λ}(B_ε(y)) ≠ 0 for all ε > 0: ofReal(e^{−(r·Λ₀·ρ)})·(ω_n·ofReal(ρ^n)) ≤ μ₀^{x,λ}(B_ρ(y)).
